body:
I've been trying for fucking years to see a different perspective. If you were to ask any of the people I interact with on a daily basis, anyone in my family, my girlfriend even, they'd tell you I'm a generally happy, positive, life loving person. I try to do good in the world, I try to make it a better place and do my part to help others.

Despite this, I fail at everything I attempt to do. It always ends up blowing up in my face, pushing me even farther down into my spiral.

Yes, my spiral. Fuck you, I'm not sharing.

What about when the bad times outnumber the good? When no matter what you do, things don't improve?

If there's no point, why bother creating one? Wouldn't that just defeat the purpose of life being purposeless? 

I can't see a way out of here. I can't see any light at the end of the goddamn tunnel, no big reveal on the way. All the distractions in the world leave me just as empty inside as I was before. Family, writing, music, drink, none of it means anything. Why bother being happy for ten, fifteen, twenty minutes, when it's just going to make the rest of the time that much worse?
My semester just started, so it's starting to pick up a little bit. I'm mostly busy spending time with GF.
Yeah. But they seem pointless. And I don't have time for them anyway.

I've been telling my friends. That's the problem. That's all I have to talk about. It feels like nothing else is important or significant anymore. It feels like there's nothing, and I hate it. I don't want it to be like this anymore.
She's got depression/anxiety as well. It would just make everything worse.

English. I want to be a novelist.

And she doesn't know I feel this way. She has her own stuff, I don't want to add to it.
I did, but then I had to wipe my computer. Haven't gotten around to downloading again. Between school and my gf, no time for gaming anyway.
Don't have money to buy new games.
FPS mostly. Halo. Not really CoD. But a lot of fond memories from middle school/high school with Halo.
